goal: Implement two-level action economy RPCs (ActivateCombatAbility, ExecuteAction) that separate ability activation from action execution

changes: Added AttacksRemaining, OffHandAttacksRemaining, FlurryStrikesRemaining fields
Added DisengageActive, DodgeActive boolean flags
Added helper methods: HasAttacks/UseAttack, HasOffHandAttacks/UseOffHandAttack, HasFlurryStrikes/UseFlurryStrike
sessions.notes: NewActionEconomyState() defaults unchanged - attacks start at 0 (granted by ATTACK ability). Pre-existing build errors in converters.go (unrelated to this change).

sessions.task: Add Input/Output types for ActivateCombatAbility and ExecuteAction
changes: Added ActivateCombatAbilityInput/Output types to service.go
Added ExecuteActionInput/Output types to service.go
Added MoveResult type for move action outcomes
Added ActivateCombatAbility and ExecuteAction method signatures to Service interface
Added stub implementations to Orchestrator (return 'not yet implemented' error)
Added stringToEntityType and intToEntitySize converter helpers
Fixed EntityType/EntitySize enum conversion in converters.go
Updated golangci.yml to exclude SA1019 deprecated warnings during transition
Regenerated mocks for updated Service interface
sessions.notes: Updated rpg-api-protos to latest generated branch (includes CombatAbilityId, ActionId enums). Build passes, all tests pass.

changes: Implemented ExecuteAction method supporting STRIKE, OFF_HAND_STRIKE, and MOVE actions
STRIKE: Validates AttacksRemaining, resolves attack via toolkit, consumes attack, handles TWF off-hand grants
OFF_HAND_STRIKE: Validates OffHandAttacksRemaining, same attack resolution as main-hand
MOVE: Validates path cube coordinates, checks movement costs (5ft/hex), wall/entity collisions
Added stop reason constants (completed, position_occupied, insufficient_movement, blocked_by_wall, invalid_coordinates)
Added executeStrike and executeMove helper methods
Uses existing buildCombatState helper for response building
Publishes MovementCompleted events for move actions
Added pb import for ActionId enum usage
Added 7 comprehensive tests covering all action types and edge cases
sessions.notes: ExecuteAction consumes granted capacity (attacks/movement). Must call ActivateCombatAbility first to grant attacks. Movement doesn't require activation - uses MovementRemaining from encounter.

changes: Implemented ActivateCombatAbility method with full ability handling
ATTACK: Checks HasAction(), consumes action, grants AttacksRemaining = 1
DASH: Checks HasAction(), consumes action, adds defaultMovementSpeed to MovementRemaining
DODGE: Checks HasAction(), consumes action, sets DodgeActive = true
DISENGAGE: Checks HasAction(), consumes action, sets DisengageActive = true
OFFHAND_ATTACK: Checks HasBonusAction(), consumes bonus action, grants OffHandAttacksRemaining = 1
Returns GrantedCapacity message describing what was granted
Added 10 comprehensive tests covering all 5 abilities and error cases
Tests verify action economy consumption, capacity grants, and turn validation
sessions.notes: Implementation was committed alongside ExecuteAction in same commit (522ba32). Validates entity's turn before allowing activation. Returns business logic failures (Success=false) vs errors for invalid state. All 10 tests pass.

sessions.task: Wire up gRPC handlers for ActivateCombatAbility and ExecuteAction
changes: Added ActivateCombatAbility handler in handler.go with validation and service call
Added ExecuteAction handler with oneof input handling for Strike and Move actions
Added convertActionEconomyToProto converter for ActionEconomy proto conversion
Added convertMoveResultToProto converter for MoveResult proto conversion
Added convertGrantedActionToProto converter for GrantedAction proto conversion
Added 12 handler tests covering success, validation, and error cases
sessions.notes: Handlers follow existing patterns (Attack, MoveCharacter). ActionEconomy converter takes CombatState for movement values. All tests pass, pre-commit passes.
